storage_root.description: Root directory where container layers, images, and metadata are stored. Must be writable by the current user.

storage_runroot.description: Runtime directory for transient storage (e.g., mount points, lock files). Can be the same as storage_root.

additional_image_stores.description: List of additional directories containing read-only container images (e.g., shared caches). Each path must be accessible by the user.

max_layer_count.description: Maximum number of overlay layers that can be stacked per container image.

uidmap_host_id.description: First host UID in the user namespace mapping (typically from /etc/subuid).

uidmap_size.description: Size of the first UID mapping block (commonly set to 65536).

uidmap_container_offset.description: First container UID offset for secondary mapping (if present).

uidmap_host_offset.description: Host UID offset for the secondary UID mapping block.

uidmap_size_offset.description: Size of the secondary UID mapping block.

gidmap_host_id.description: First host GID in the user namespace mapping (typically from /etc/subgid).

gidmap_size.description: Size of the first GID mapping block.

gidmap_container_offset.description: First container GID offset for secondary mapping.

gidmap_host_offset.description: Host GID offset for the secondary GID mapping block.

gidmap_size_offset.description: Size of the secondary GID mapping block.

fuse_overlayfs_enabled.description: If true, forces use of fuse-overlayfs (required for rootless when no kernel overlay is available).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity level for container storage operations.

mountopt.description: Comma-separated mount options for the overlay filesystem. Leave empty for defaults.

workers.description: Number of parallel workers used for image operations (e.g., copy, verification).

disable_vfs_fallback.description: If true, disables fallback to VFS-based operations if overlay mount fails.

imagestore.description: Path to an additional image store directory (e.g., for sharing images across users).

use_mount_program.description: If true, uses an external mount program (e.g., fuse-overlayfs) instead of kernel overlay.

mount_program.description: Path to the mount program binary (typically fuse-overlayfs).

mountopt_fuse.description: List of mount options passed directly to fuse-overlayfs.
